name: BigBasket
description: Search products, manage cart, and place grocery orders on BigBasket
author: flock

requires.description: Log in to BigBasket via the dashboard browser session to access grocery shopping
requires.rationale: BigBasket has no public API — a saved browser session is how the agent shops on your behalf.

browser.setup_instructions: Log in to your BigBasket account via the dashboard. Ensure your delivery address is set to the correct location before connecting.

checkout.reason: pay reads the page, clicks on to the payment page and its UPI option with payment capture on: four browser steps with waits (each 2s apart). Killed at 30s, the person is left with a half-opened payment page.

list-addresses.reason: Loads the home page, opens the header's address picker and waits up to 8s for its saved addresses.

set-delivery-location.reason: Opens the address picker, reads the saved addresses, clicks the matching one and waits for the page (and a change-address prompt) to settle: three browser steps with waits.

empty-cart.reason: Removes cart lines one at a time (each unit, where only a minus is shown), waiting for the page after each: up to 70s for a full cart.

view-cart.reason: Waits up to 10s for the cart lines or its empty message, then reads the lines and every bill row.
